review.review: Final integration reviewed and validated; independent source reviews included. No managed public activation claimed.

behavior: A concrete immutable consumer descriptor is sealed with the genuine original request and adds its fixed representations once to R; existing providers explicitly reject before old hooks or work.

The consumed bank returns its actual consumer association and core validates it inside Admission before Prompt/Sampling. Native code forwards only the neutral claim through existing original producers.

The private typed facade wrapper advances the same cursor/readiness algorithm and transfers its sole original owner through failures and frozen results; preparation failures retire the empty cursor first while ordinary causes retire before the owning cursor.

Constructor mismatch returns unchanged sequence before creating a typed failure. Equal-size foreign identities, original exact/short admission, full/raw source transitions and result/iterator/error retirement have behavioral coverage.
Single native text segments return their existing handle without an intermediate cloned-array vector; multi-segment extraction borrows original handles and preserves validation/order.
Recovery nodes preserve the original Box through callback failures and detached-list unwinding; successful consuming dispatch unboxes before probe and retained payload under the same native guard.
Poisoned callbacks report unsettled/blocked and are never retried; only unfinished native thread capture bookkeeping seals before handoff. Completion extraction ends its slot loan before callbacks.
Ordinary host retirement concretely unboxes the existing node before payload Drop while preserving detached snapshot, native-lock exclusion, reentry and TLS/unwind deferral.
limits: Public loaded/control routing and public Vec result migration remain unfinished.
Fixed consumer representations do not bound tokenizer/parser/grammar/decoder/source/error/event/journal transitive payloads; required unknown bounds cannot activate managed work.
Exact simultaneous Recovery node/native Scope populations and full native opening/inventory/error ownership remain separate obligations.
Requested managed storage bounds do not guarantee process RSS or allocator usable size.
